CCK-induced contraction is dependent on the activation of multiple pathways that involve the production of DAG, AA and their metabolites.

CCK induces contraction in guinea pig gallbladder by activating PC-PLC and PI-PLC, as well as PLD to produce DAG, and that the subsequent production of AA is a major modulator of the CCK-induced response.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
